title: Scaffold project: pyproject, src layout, Typer CLI
description:
Create the Python project skeleton for tiktok-cli at /Users/tranquangdang21/Projects/tiktok_cli.

Context: PLAN.md at repo root is the full spec. MVP = TikTok URL -> transcript files, no login, no LLM. Python 3.11+ chosen because faster-whisper/mlx-whisper and yt-dlp are Python-native; whisper.cpp was rejected (needs cmake build, slower on Apple Silicon than mlx-whisper).

Deliverables:
- pyproject.toml: name=tiktok-cli, requires-python>=3.11, deps: typer>=0.12, rich>=13.7, yt-dlp>=2025.1, faster-whisper>=1.1 (ctranslate2>=4.6.3 floor matters for new GPUs). Optional extra `mlx`: mlx-whisper>=0.4. Entry point `tiktok = tiktok_cli.cli:app`.
- src/tiktok_cli/__init__.py with __version__.
- src/tiktok_cli/cli.py: Typer app, registers subcommands (transcript, batch, info, search, list, tag, trending, discover, doctor). Lazy-import command modules inside callback so `tiktok --help` stays <100ms.
- Empty __init__.py for core/ and commands/.
- tests/ + tests/fixtures/ dirs, .gitignore (venv, *.egg-info, tiktok-transcripts/, __pycache__).
- Verify: `uv sync` (or pip install -e .) then `tiktok --help` works.

Do NOT add torch, openai-whisper, pydub — lean dep tree per PLAN.md.

title: core/errors.py: UserError + yt-dlp error translation
description:
Create src/tiktok_cli/core/errors.py.

Purpose: single error type + yt-dlp exception translation so commands never leak raw tracebacks.

Spec:
- class UserError(Exception): msg, hint (optional), exit_code (default 1). __str__ renders 'error: msg' + 'hint: ...' on stderr.
- translate_download_error(exc) -> UserError: port the _ERROR_RULES table from omni-transcriber/src/transcriber/downloader.py (already cloned at /Users/tranquangdang21/Projects/.tmp/repos/omni-transcriber/). Match case-insensitive substrings in order: 'private video', 'members-only'/'join this channel', 'not available in your country'/'blocked it in your country', 'sign in to confirm'/'login required'/'requires authentication'/'empty media response'/'not granting access'/'--cookies-from-browser', 'rate-limit reached', 'confirm your age', 'unsupported url', 'video unavailable', 'unable to download webpage', 'no supported javascript runtime' (hint: install Deno/Node). Cookie-related hints must suggest `--cookies-from-browser firefox` or `--cookies FILE`.
- Commands catch UserError -> print to stderr, exit with code. Never catch bare Exception at top level without translate.

title: core/url.py: classify TikTok URLs
description:
Create src/tiktok_cli/core/url.py.

Purpose: classify a TikTok URL before we spend a yt-dlp call on it. Port logic from the Chrome extension /Users/tranquangdang21/Projects/.tmp/repos/tiktok-transcript/lib/tiktok.js (classifyTikTokUrl, videoIdFromUrl).

Spec:
- Hosts: tiktok.com, www.tiktok.com, m.tiktok.com, vm.tiktok.com, vt.tiktok.com.
- classify_url(url) -> Literal['video','photo','profile','feed','short','other']:
  - /@user/video/<digits> or /v/<digits> or /video/<digits> -> video
  - /@user/photo/<digits> -> photo
  - vm./vt. host or /t/<slug> path -> short (resolves to video)
  - /, /foryou, /following, /explore, /friends, /live -> feed
  - /@user (bare profile) -> profile
  - else -> other
- video_id_from_url(url) -> str|None: extract digits from /video/ path only (NOT from shortlinks — those need yt-dlp resolution).
- is_tiktok_url(url) -> bool.
- Unit tests in tests/test_url.py (no network).

title: core/captions.py: VTT parse, pick, dedupe, render
description:
Create src/tiktok_cli/core/captions.py — VTT parsing and transcript rendering. This is the highest-value pure module; port from /Users/tranquangdang21/Projects/.tmp/repos/skills/skills/tiktok-transcript/scripts/fetch-tiktok-transcript.py (parse_vtt, strip_vtt_markup, plain_text_from_cues) and omni-transcriber formats.py.

Spec:
- @dataclass Cue: start(float), end(float), start_time(str HH:MM:SS.mmm), end_time(str), text(str).
- parse_vtt(path) -> list[Cue]: handle WEBVTT header, NOTE/STYLE blocks, cue identifiers on separate line, '-->' timing line (may have settings after end time — take first token), inline tags <c>, <00:00:00.000>, <b>, <i>, {\an8} ASS overrides — strip all, html.unescape, collapse whitespace. Skip empty text. DEDUPE consecutive identical texts (TikTok auto-captions repeat).
- pick_caption_file(vtt_paths, preference=('vie','vi','en','en-US')) -> Path|None: prefer manual subs over auto (filename pattern .%(lang)s.vtt vs auto naming), then language preference order, else first sorted.
- cues_to_paragraphs(cues, gap_threshold=2.0) -> list[str]: merge cues into paragraphs breaking on >2s gaps (dedene plain_text_from_cues logic).
- render functions (all pure, return str ending with single \n):
  - render_txt(cues, timestamps=False): paragraphs or '[mm:ss] text' lines
  - render_srt(cues): numbered blocks 'HH:MM:SS,mmm --> HH:MM:SS,mmm'
  - render_vtt(cues): WEBVTT header + 'HH:MM:SS.mmm --> HH:MM:SS.mmm'
  - render_json(cues, meta): {source:{...}, language, duration, segments:[{start,end,text}]}
  - render_md(cues, meta): '# title' + metadata bullets + timestamped lines
- Unit tests in tests/test_captions.py using tests/fixtures/sample.vtt + expected_cues.json (golden).

title: tests fixtures: sample.vtt, tiktok_info.json, urls.txt
description:
Create test fixtures under tests/fixtures/ used by unit tests (no network needed).

Files:
- sample.vtt: realistic TikTok-style WebVTT with <c> color tags, karaoke-style <00:00:00.000> timestamps, duplicate consecutive cues, and a NOTE/STYLE header — exercises parse_vtt edge cases.
- tiktok_info.json: minimal yt-dlp info dict shape for a TikTok video (id, title, uploader, uploader_id, duration, upload_date, webpage_url, view_count, like_count, comment_count, subtitles{}, automatic_captions{}).
- urls.txt: batch input example — comments (#), blank lines, one long URL, one vm.tiktok.com shortlink.
- expected_cues.json: the cues parse_vtt should produce from sample.vtt (for golden testing).

Keep fixtures small (<5KB each). All content synthetic — no real TikTok data.

title: core/downloader.py: yt-dlp wrapper (info, subs, audio)
description:
Create src/tiktok_cli/core/downloader.py — the ONLY module allowed to import yt_dlp (isolation per omni-transcriber downloader.py pattern).

Reference implementations to study:
- /Users/tranquangdang21/Projects/.tmp/repos/omni-transcriber/src/transcriber/downloader.py (YDL options, error surfacing, js_runtimes)
- /Users/tranquangdang21/Projects/.tmp/repos/skills/skills/tiktok-transcript/scripts/fetch-tiktok-transcript.py (TikTok subtitle gotchas)
- /Users/tranquangdang21/Projects/.tmp/repos/gerardnico/transcribe/src/gerardnico/transcribe/social.py (sub-lang regex, cookie template)

CRITICAL TikTok gotcha (from dedene/skills SKILL.md): caption info does NOT appear in yt-dlp's extract_info JSON for TikTok even when captions exist — must use --list-subs or actually request subtitle download. Design list_subtitles() to run YDL with writesubtitles+skip_download into a temp dir, then glob *.vtt. Do NOT trust info['subtitles']/['automatic_captions'] alone; verify at runtime, keep a TODO comment.

Spec:
- class YtdlpClient(cookies_from_browser=None, cookies_file=None, verbose=False)
- extract_info(url) -> dict: YoutubeDL({'quiet','no_warnings','noplaylist','socket_timeout':30,'retries':3,'js_runtimes':_enabled_js_runtimes()}).extract_info(url, download=False). _enabled_js_runtimes() = enable deno/node/quickjs/bun that exist on PATH (copy omni-transcriber logic).
- download_subtitles(url, out_dir, langs='vi.*,en.*,all') -> list[Path]: YDL opts skip_download, writesubtitles, writeautomaticsub, subformats ['vtt'], sublangs, outtmpl out_dir/%(id)s.%(ext)s. Return .vtt files found.
- download_audio(url, tmp_dir) -> Path: format 'bestaudio/best', outtmpl tmp_dir/%(id)s.%(ext)s. NO FFmpegExtractAudio postprocessor — faster-whisper/PyAV decodes any container.
- All yt-dlp exceptions -> raise translated via core.errors.translate_download_error (wrap in try, re-raise UserError).
- Cookies: only set cookiesfrombrowser/cookiefile opts when args provided.

title: core/artifacts.py: output layout, metadata.json, index.jsonl
description:
Create src/tiktok_cli/core/artifacts.py — output layout + idempotency + index.

Layout (from PLAN.md):
  <output_dir>/VIDEO_ID/
    source.info.json     # raw yt-dlp info, write once
    metadata.json        # compact subset
    transcript.{vtt,srt,txt,json,md}
    audio.wav            # whisper path only, deleted unless --keep-audio
  <output_dir>/index.jsonl  # append-only run log

Spec:
- sanitize_video_id(raw) -> str: must match ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{6,}$ else raise UserError (yt-dlp ids are already safe; validate anyway).
- class VideoDir: .path, .video_id; methods is_processed() (transcript.json exists), write_source_info(info), write_metadata(compact), write_transcripts(rendered: dict[fmt,str]), append_index(record: dict).
- compact_metadata(info, transcript_source, cue_count) -> dict: id,title,uploader,uploader_id,duration,upload_date,webpage_url,language,view_count,like_count,comment_count,transcript_source,cue_count,processed_at (ISO8601 UTC).
- append_index(output_dir, record): open index.jsonl 'a', write json.dumps(ensure_ascii=False)+'\n'. Record fields: video_id,url,status('caption'|'whisper'|'no-captions'|'no-audio'|'failed'),language,cue_count,duration,artifact_dir,error?,processed_at.
- render_all_formats(cues, meta) -> dict[str,str]: calls captions.render_* for txt/srt/vtt/json/md/all.

title: commands/transcript.py: caption path end-to-end
description:
Implement commands/transcript.py — caption-first path of `tiktok transcript <urls...>`.

This is THE core MVP command. Register in cli.py.

Flags (Typer):
- urls: list[str] argument (1+)
- -o/--output-dir PATH default ./tiktok-transcripts
- -l/--language STR (whisper hint, used later)
- --whisper auto|always|never default auto
- --engine auto|faster|mlx default auto (used by whisper path bead)
- -m/--model STR default 'small' (used by whisper path bead)
- --format txt|srt|vtt|json|md|all default all
- --keep-audio flag
- --refresh flag
- --cookies-from-browser STR, --cookies PATH (optional)
- -v/--verbose

Flow per URL (sequential; parallel is phase-5):
1. classify_url: photo->status photo-post skip; feed/profile/other->UserError.
2. info = downloader.extract_info(url) -> video_id = info['id'] (NEVER parse from URL — shortlinks).
3. Cache: VideoDir.is_processed() and not --refresh -> print artifact path, continue.
4. CAPTION PATH (default): downloader.download_subtitles(url, video_dir/'subs') -> pick_caption_file -> parse_vtt -> render_all_formats -> write files. transcript_source='tiktok-captions:<ext-lang>'.
5. If no caption file and --whisper != never: DEFER to whisper path (implemented in sibling bead cmd-transcript-whisper; for THIS bead raise not-implemented marker or leave hook function process_with_whisper(url, ctx) stub that the other bead fills).
6. If no caption and --whisper never: status='no-captions', still write metadata.json + index entry.
7. Write source.info.json once, metadata.json, append index.jsonl, print ONE compact stdout line per video: `VIDEO_ID | source | cues=N | dir`. Progress bars/details -> stderr via rich Console(stderr=True). stdout carries ONLY machine-usable output (omni-transcriber constraint).

Verification: run against a real captioned TikTok URL manually; unit-testable parts mocked.

title: core/stt.py: faster-whisper + mlx-whisper engines
description:
Create src/tiktok_cli/core/stt.py — speech-to-text engines. Dual-backend pattern from /Users/tranquangdang21/Projects/.tmp/repos/douyin-teardown/content_extractor/video/transcribe.py and stt-local-english engine.py.

Engine selection: 'auto' -> mlx on darwin+arm64 if mlx_whisper imports, else faster-whisper. Flags --engine auto|faster|mlx override.

Anti-hallucination settings (MANDATORY, from douyin-teardown):
- faster-whisper: vad_filter=True, condition_on_previous_text=False, beam_size=1, temperature=0.0
- mlx-whisper: condition_on_previous_text=False, temperature=0.0, initial_prompt optional
- Drop segments with no_speech_prob > 0.6 (faster-whisper exposes it; mlx segment dict has 'no_speech_prob').

Model mapping:
- faster: names as-is (tiny|base|small|medium|large-v3|turbo|distil-large-v3|HF repo|local path). DEFAULT 'small' (user decision).
- mlx: map short names via table -> mlx-community/whisper-{name}-mlx; 'small' -> mlx-community/whisper-small-mlx. 'turbo' -> mlx-community/whisper-large-v3-turbo.

Spec:
- @dataclass STTResult: cues (reuse captions.Cue), language, duration, engine, model, elapsed_s.
- class FasterEngine: lazy WhisperModel cache keyed by (model,device,compute_type); transcribe(audio_path, language=None) -> STTResult. device/compute_type 'auto'.
- class MlxEngine: mlx_whisper.transcribe(path_or_hf_repo=repo, language=..., word_timestamps=False, verbose=False) -> parse result['segments'].
- resolve_engine(name) -> engine instance or UserError with install hint.
- whisper_available() -> bool for doctor command.
- heavy imports (faster_whisper, mlx_whisper) INSIDE methods/functions, never module top — `tiktok --help` must stay fast.

title: transcript whisper fallback path + flags
description:
Add the Whisper fallback path to commands/transcript.py, completing `tiktok transcript`.

Depends on core/stt.py (FasterEngine/MlxEngine) and downloader.download_audio.

Behavior:
- Triggered when download_subtitles yields no usable .vtt AND --whisper != never. --whisper always skips caption attempt entirely.
- Steps: download_audio(url, tmp workdir inside VideoDir) -> engine.transcribe(audio, language=args.language or None) -> STTResult.cues -> render_all_formats -> write transcripts. transcript_source='whisper:<engine>:<model>:<lang>'.
- Audio cleanup: delete audio file after success unless --keep-audio. On failure keep for debug? NO — delete, error message suffices (disk hygiene decision).
- Model load is SLOW first time (~466MB download for small) — print stderr note 'Downloading Whisper model small (~466MB, one-time)' before engine call; reuse engine instance across URLs in same invocation (create once per command run, pass into per-url processor).
- Language: pass --language to engine; auto-detect when None. Record detected language in metadata + index.
- Edge: video with no audio stream -> yt-dlp/faster-whisper error -> translate to UserError('video has no audio track'), status='no-audio' in index, continue batch.
- Flags already declared in caption bead: --engine, --model, --language, --keep-audio, --whisper.

Acceptance: a real no-caption TikTok video produces transcript.{txt,srt,vtt,json,md} with timestamps; Vietnamese transcript quality with 'small' acceptable for agent reading.

title: commands/batch.py: batch file processing + summary
description:
Implement commands/batch.py — `tiktok batch <file>`.

Input file format: one URL per line, '#' comments and blank lines ignored, leading/trailing whitespace stripped. Reuse tests/fixtures/urls.txt as example.

Behavior:
- Read file (FileNotFound -> UserError). Parse URLs, dedupe preserving order.
- For each URL: run the SAME per-video pipeline as transcript command (extract shared helper process_video(url, ctx) in commands/transcript.py or core/pipeline.py — refactor so both commands call it; do NOT duplicate logic).
- Per-video isolation: try/except UserError per URL -> record failed, continue. Never abort whole batch on one bad URL.
- Progress: rich progress bar 'X/N' on stderr; per-video result line.
- End-of-batch summary table on stdout: counts by status (caption/whisper/no-captions/no-audio/failed/skipped-cached) + failed URLs list with reasons.
- Inherits all transcript flags (--output-dir, --whisper, --engine, --model, --format, --keep-audio, --refresh, cookies, -v). Add --jobs N later (phase 5, out of scope now — sequential only, document it).

Acceptance: batch of 10 mixed URLs (some captioned, some not, one invalid) completes with correct per-status counts and all artifacts written.

title: commands/doctor.py: dependency health check
description:
Implement commands/doctor.py — `tiktok doctor` health check.

Print a table (rich) of checks, each PASS/WARN/FAIL + fix hint:
- yt-dlp: version via yt_dlp.version.__version__ (import inside function); WARN if < 2025.1.
- Python >= 3.11.
- faster-whisper importable (try import); model 'small' cached? Check HF cache dir for faster-whisper-small* — WARN 'will download ~466MB on first use' if absent.
- mlx-whisper: only check on darwin+arm64; report which engine auto would pick.
- ffmpeg on PATH: WARN-only (not required — faster-whisper/PyAV decodes directly; only edge cases need it).
- tt binary: which('tt') -> PASS with version (`tt --version` or `tt version`), else INFO 'optional, needed for search/list/tag/trending/discover — install: go install github.com/tamnd/tiktok-cli/cmd/tt@latest'.
- Network: quick HEAD/GET to https://www.tiktok.com with 5s timeout -> PASS/FAIL 'cannot reach tiktok.com'.
- Output dir writability: touch test file in ./tiktok-transcripts.

Exit code 0 if no FAIL, 1 if any FAIL (CI/script friendly). All checks lazy-import heavy deps.

title: core/discovery.py: tt binary wrapper (JSONL)
description:
Create src/tiktok_cli/core/discovery.py — wrapper around the external `tt` binary (github.com/tamnd/tiktok-cli, Go, single binary, no login, MIT).

Why tt instead of own implementation: tt already reimplements TikTok web signing (X-Bogus + msToken, pkg/ttsign) and SSR blob parsing. Reimplementing in Python = fragile + months of work. We subprocess it.

What tt provides (verified by reading its source at /Users/tranquangdang21/Projects/.tmp/repos/tiktok-cli):
- video/user/posts/comments/replies/hashtag/sound/search/users/trending/discover/raw commands
- Output formats: table, json, jsonl, csv, tsv, url, raw
- `tt serve` HTTP and `tt mcp` MCP modes exist but we only need CLI JSONL
- Honest ErrWalled when TikTok WAF challenges; rate limit 600ms built-in

Spec:
- tt_available() -> bool via shutil.which('tt')
- run_tt(args: list[str]) -> list[dict]: subprocess.run(['tt', *args, '--format', 'jsonl'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120). Parse stdout line-delimited JSON. Non-zero exit or empty stdout -> raise UserError from core.errors with stderr tail as detail. Detect WAF: stderr/stdout containing 'walled'/'challenge'/'403' -> UserError('TikTok served a WAF challenge — wait and retry, or reduce request rate', hint='tt search/discover hit the signed API plane; tt video/user are SSR-plane and sturdier').
- Helpers (each raises UserError('tt not installed...install: go install github.com/tamnd/tiktok-cli/cmd/tt@latest') when missing):
  - video_info(url) -> dict: tt video <url>
  - search(keyword, limit=20) -> list[dict]: tt search <kw> -n <limit>
  - user_posts(handle, limit=30): tt posts @handle -n <limit>  (handle with or without @)
  - hashtag_videos(tag, limit): tt hashtag <tag> --videos -n <limit>
  - trending(limit): tt trending -n <limit>
  - discover(seeds: list[str], top=20): tt discover --seed-video/--seed-hashtag ... --top N — build args from seed types (seed-video for /video/ URLs, --seed-hashtag for #tag, --seed-user for @handle; check tt --help for exact flags at implement time)
- All helpers return parsed dicts/lists; commands format for display. Keep ALL tt CLI knowledge in this module.
- Unit-testable: mock subprocess.run; no real tt needed for tests.

title: commands/info.py: video metadata command
description:
Implement commands/info.py — `tiktok info <url>`.

Fast metadata-only command, no download, no transcript.

- Uses downloader.extract_info(url) (yt-dlp, download=False).
- Prints compact JSON to stdout: id,title,uploader,uploader_id,duration (s),upload_date (YYYY-MM-DD converted from YYYYMMDD),webpage_url,view_count,like_count,comment_count,repost_count,language,hashtags (from tags/challenges),music {title,author} if present,has_captions (bool — best-effort from info['subtitles']/['automatic_captions'] keys, NOTE the TikTok gotcha: these may be empty even when captions exist; label field 'captions_reported' to be honest),subtitles_available (list of lang codes seen).
- -o/--output FILE optional: write JSON to file instead of stdout.
- Errors: classify_url first (photo/feed/profile -> still allow info? YES — info works for any TikTok page yt-dlp supports; only 'other' non-TikTok -> UserError).
- --cookies flags same as transcript.
- This command is the cheap 'should I transcript this?' probe for agents.

title: commands/search.py + list.py + tag.py + trending.py
description:
Implement commands/search.py, list.py (user posts), tag.py (hashtag videos), trending.py — thin display commands over core/discovery.py tt helpers.

Shared pattern: call discovery helper -> format results as aligned table (rich) on stdout OR --json flag for raw JSONL passthrough (agent-friendly). Every command accepts -n/--limit (default 20) and --json.

- `tiktok search <keyword>`: discovery.search() -> columns: type | author | title/desc | url. Videos get full tiktok.com/@user/video/id URL if tt didn't supply one (construct from author+id).
- `tiktok list <@handle|url>`: normalize handle (strip @, accept profile URL -> extract handle) -> discovery.user_posts() -> table: id | date | duration | views | likes | title | url.
- `tiktok tag <#tag|tag>`: strip leading # -> discovery.hashtag_videos() -> same video table.
- `tiktok trending`: discovery.trending() -> same video table.
- All: tt missing -> UserError with install hint (graceful degrade, transcript/batch unaffected). WAF -> UserError with retry hint.
- Do NOT implement own TikTok search/scraping — tt or nothing. yt-dlp has no TikTok keyword search.

title: commands/discover.py: graph walk command
description:
Implement commands/discover.py — `tiktok discover` graph-walk command over tt discover.

- Args: --seed-video URL (repeatable), --seed-hashtag TAG (repeatable), --seed-user HANDLE (repeatable), --top N (default 20), --depth N (default 2, pass to tt if supported), --json.
- At least one seed required -> else UserError with usage example.
- Map seeds to tt discover flags (verify exact flag names via `tt discover --help` at implementation time; tt discover.go uses --seed-video, and discover_op.go defines seed kinds user/hashtag/sound/video/search/trending).
- Output: ranked node table — kind | score | id/title | via-edge | url. --json dumps raw.
- This is the 'find me videos about X' engine for the research workflow: discover -> pick video URLs -> feed to `tiktok transcript`/`batch`. Document this pipeline in README.
- WAF/budget: tt discover has built-in depth/max-nodes/max-requests/deadline — expose --max-nodes/--max-requests if tt supports; default conservative (depth 2, top 20) since signed API plane walls easily.

title: README.md: install, usage, limitations, model guide
description:
Write README.md for tiktok-cli. Audience: technical users + AI agents that will call the CLI.

Required sections:
- One-line pitch: 'TikTok URL -> local transcript files. No login, no LLM, no transcript websites.'
- Install: `uv tool install` from git or `pipx install`; or `uv run` PEP723-style. Deps auto: yt-dlp, faster-whisper. Optional: `pip install tiktok-cli[mlx]` on Apple Silicon for faster mlx-whisper. Optional: `go install github.com/tamnd/tiktok-cli/cmd/tt@latest` for discovery commands.
- Quickstart: `tiktok transcript <url>` -> show artifact tree output.
- Commands table: transcript/batch/info/search/list/tag/trending/discover/doctor with one-line each.
- How it works: caption-first (TikTok auto-captions via yt-dlp VTT) -> whisper fallback (faster-whisper int8 / mlx-whisper on M-series) -> 5 output formats. Include the yt-dlp caption gotcha note (captions invisible in dump-json).
- Models table: tiny/base/small(default)/medium/turbo/large-v3-turbo sizes + when to upgrade for Vietnamese quality.
- Output layout tree (from PLAN.md section 4).
- Limitations (honest): private/deleted/age-gated fail; WAF may rate-limit discovery; caption coverage depends on creator; no login = public videos only; search is best-effort.
- Agent usage: example prompt showing agent calling `tiktok transcript` then reading transcript.txt; note stdout is pipe-safe, logs on stderr.
- Development: uv sync, pytest, ruff.

title: Unit tests: captions, url, artifacts, stt, errors
description:
Write comprehensive unit tests — ALL must run with NO network and NO model downloads (CI-safe). Use tests/fixtures/ + mocks.

Coverage required:
- test_captions.py: parse_vtt on sample.vtt vs expected_cues.json golden (tags stripped, dup cues removed, timestamps parsed); pick_caption_file preference order (vie manual > en auto > first); cues_to_paragraphs gap splitting; all 5 renderers output shape (srt numbering, vtt WEBVTT header, json schema keys, md title).
- test_url.py: classify_url every path type (video/photo/profile/feed/short/other), is_tiktok_url hosts incl vm./vt., video_id_from_url rejects shortlinks.
- test_artifacts.py: sanitize_video_id accepts/rejects; VideoDir.is_processed logic; compact_metadata fields; append_index writes valid JSONL append (use tmp_path).
- test_stt.py: resolve_engine auto logic (mock platform/imports); _MLX model name mapping table; engine selection errors -> UserError. Mock faster_whisper/mlx_whisper modules — never import real ones.
- test_errors.py: translate_download_error maps 'private video'/'rate-limit'/'sign in'/unknown -> correct UserError messages+exit codes.
- test_downloader.py: mock yt_dlp.YoutubeDL — verify opts dict keys (writesubtitles, sublangs, noplaylist, js_runtimes); download_subtitles globs .vtt; error wrapping -> UserError. Patch sys.modules['yt_dlp'] before import.
- test_discovery.py: mock subprocess.run — JSONL parsing, tt-missing UserError, WAF detection, helper arg construction (verify tt argv flags match real tt CLI).

title: Integration checklist: real TikTok videos (vi/en/no-caption/shortlink/private/batch)
description:
Manual integration checklist — run after implementation, before release. Requires real network + TikTok access; NOT in CI.

Checklist (record results in bead comments):
1. Captioned Vietnamese video URL -> transcript path, verify transcript.txt reads naturally, transcript.json has cues.
2. Captioned English video -> same.
3. No-caption video (old video or creator-disabled) -> whisper path with 'small', Vietnamese quality acceptable, elapsed time noted.
4. vm.tiktok.com shortlink -> resolves, video_id correct.
5. Private/deleted video -> graceful failed status, index.jsonl entry has error.
6. Photo post URL -> status photo-post, no crash.
7. batch urls.txt with 10 mixed URLs -> correct summary counts.
8. `tiktok info <url>` -> JSON fields sane.
9. `tiktok doctor` -> all checks run, exit 0 on healthy machine.
10. If tt installed: `tiktok search`, `tiktok trending`, `tiktok discover --seed-video` -> tables render; if WAF hit, error message is the friendly one.
11. Re-run transcript on same URL -> cache skip (no re-download).
12. --refresh forces re-fetch.

Known-flaky acceptable: TikTok may WAF-block datacenter IPs; test from residential connection.
notes: Verified live: caption path (eng-US auto-captions, 40 cues), whisper fallback (faster/small, 30 cues, all 5 formats + metadata + index.jsonl), skipped-cached idempotency, doctor, graceful tt-missing error. Not yet covered: Vietnamese video, vm./vt. shortlink, private video, 10-URL batch.
